plan.summary: BRO-2882: 71 edits on 35 review files whose humanReviewScore was written by the text-only extractor prepass (a machine star read) instead of a person. Each is marked humanReviewScoreProvisional=true with a note, so getBestScore falls through to the stored originalScore / anchored LLM score. orphans-2013/timeout--david-cote also has its originalScore cleared: its 5/5 came from page chrome about a different show. joe-turners-come-and-gone-2026/nypost--johnny-oleksinski is left alone: an operator _locked it. Two duplicate files (sinatra thestage--unknown, trainspotting city-am--unknown) are skipped: they are already excluded as duplicateOf a named sibling. (part 2 of 3)
steps: Set humanReviewScoreProvisional=true and a humanReviewNote on each file.
